fact: A planet at Barnard's Star — the storied sci-fi sun that eluded planet-hunters for a century.
bio: Barnard's Star, the second-nearest star system at six light-years, is a fixture of science fiction — the destination of the British Interplanetary Society's 1970s 'Project Daedalus' starship study and a waypoint in interstellar fiction from Robert Forward’s Rocheworld to the later Rama novels. After a century of claimed planets that all evaporated under scrutiny, Barnard b was finally confirmed in 2024: a sub-Earth far too hot for life, but real at last.
